test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

She said to her friend, "What a beautiful painting you have made!"

options.text: She exclaimed to her friend that she had made a very beautiful painting,
She told her that the painting is beautiful.
She exclaimed to her friend that she made a very beautiful painting.
She shouted that painting was very nice.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in direct speech, and the task is to convert it into indirect speech while retaining its essence.
 
• The exclamation "What a beautiful painting you have made!" expresses strong admiration, which should be conveyed using the verb "exclaimed" in indirect speech.
 
• Option 1 correctly conveys this admiration with the phrase "She exclaimed to her friend that she had made a very beautiful painting."
 
• Other options fail to accurately capture the exclamatory tone or use incorrect sentence structures.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She exclaimed to her friend that she had made a very beautiful painting."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "She told her that the painting is beautiful." – This option fails to convey the exclamatory tone and admiration expressed in the original sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** "She exclaimed to her friend that she made a very beautiful painting." – Incorrect
 
• **Option 4:** "She shouted that painting was very nice." – This option misrepresents the tone and meaning of the original sentence.
